data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin that wraps the native Atomic Transact SDKs.
data.what_it_does: Provides a native implementation for the Atomic Transact SDK, letting users launch the Transact flow with custom presentation styles on iOS and Android. It handles asynchronous data requests and task status updates during the flow.
use_when: You need to integrate the Atomic Transact SDK into your Flutter application
You want to handle native Atomic Transact callbacks like data requests and task updates
avoid_when: You are not using the Atomic Transact service
You need an alternative payment or auth gateway not tied to Atomic
strengths: Direct wrapper for the native Atomic Transact SDKs
Supports custom presentation styles for iOS and Android
Allows handling asynchronous data requests from Transact
weaknesses: Requires specific native configuration (minSdkVersion 21 for Android, iOS 14.0 for iOS)
data.setup_notes: Requires setting the minSdkVersion to 21 or greater in android/app/build.gradle and targeting iOS 14.0 or greater with Xcode 12.0+
